sql:
SELECT L.ID 
FROM Laboratory L 
JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID 
WHERE L.Date = E.`Examination Date` 
  AND E.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' 
  AND L.GPT > 30 
  AND L.ALB < 4
GROUP BY L.ID
